name: The Arcana: Nevivon Tales
source:
Discover who our heroes used to be before their main adventure. The fearless captain overcame one of the worst storms in her life. Little does she know, the storm will bring her not only new experiences but also new encounters.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
了解我们的英雄在进行主要冒险之前曾经是谁。这位无所畏惧的船长克服了她一生中最严重的风暴之一。殊不知，这场风暴给她带来的不仅是新的经历，还有新的遭遇。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
